newsitem.title: UK: Royal & Sun gains in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Royal & Sun gains in active trade.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc rose more than six percent in busy trade with investors piling into a stock whose value was highlighted last week by Goldman Sachs, dealers said.
Dealers said Goldman was aggressively bidding on the stock today. No one at Goldman was immediately available to comment.
The shares rose 31p to 510p by 1317 GMT with more than eleven million shares changing hands.
Last week Goldman raised its recommendation on the stock, adding it to its "top European priority" list and lifting profit forecasts.
